messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: p99 latency > 10s for /v1/generate (prod, us-west-2). Trigger: latency_slo_breach. Alert keys: customer-facing.
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. seeing spike across multiple fleets, p95 ~ 350ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~ 3s -> 12s. Streaming stalls reported.
Jamie (sre): attaching quick flamegraph link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/flows?panel=tail-latency (looks like continuous-batching queue depth spike)
Rafael (runtime): +1. logs show batch queue accumulating big sequences: a bunch of requests with seq_len>1500 hitting cont-batcher and blocking.
Lina (eng-oncall): Can we temporarily isolate long seqs to a separate queue? Runbook step 4: split-by-seqlen.
Maya (oncall): Taking action: paging cont-batcher config -> lowering max_batch_size and enabling strict fairness. Will run patch now.
Maya (oncall): Command: ```kubectl -n inference patch cm cont-batcher-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"32","fair_scheduling":"true","long_seq_threshold":"1024"}}'```
Rafael (runtime): Copy. Also will flip on kv-cache bypass for streaming-heavy routes to reduce stall tail.
Jamie (sre): While Maya patches, I'm spinning up dedicated small pool for seq_len>1024 to avoid head-of-line blocking. kubectl scale deploy cont-batcher-longseq --replicas=3
Carol (support): Heads up — we have 2 customers on high SLO (acct: finproto) showing errors in their dashboards, they're likely to page. I'll draft a proactive note.
support-bot: Ticket created INC-2026: "High p99 on /v1/generate (us-west-2)" — assigned to eng-oncall. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026
Maya (oncall): Patch applied. Observability: queue depth dropping, p95 recovering to ~400ms, p99 still noisy.
Jamie (sre): Saw some streaming connections stuck in ESTABLISHED with no bytes for 60s — might be client-side chunks? I'll terminate a few stale connections to test.
Rafael (runtime): Confirmed a codepath in continuous batching that merges small + very large sequences into same batch resulting in high tail. We should change batching policy: prefer grouping similar token counts.
Lina (eng-oncall): Truncate/early-accept heuristic option in runbook step 7 might help short-term. Anyone want to own a hotfix?
Richard (platform): I can cut a configuration hotfix and roll canary to 10% of traffic. Will coordinate with Maya.
Maya (oncall): Please do canary. Also enabling fallback model route for critical customers to a low-latency variant (gpt-micro) while we stabilize.
Carol (support): Notifying FinProto and RetailCorp with a short status: "We are mitigating a latency regression tied to mixed-length batching; we've applied mitigation and are routing critical traffic to a low-latency fallback. We'll follow up with RCA."
Jamie (sre): After canary, p99 on canary group stable ~950ms. Production p99 coming down slowly.
Rafael (runtime): Pushed flag to batching scheduler: prefer-homogeneous-batches=true. This reduces mixing probability. Observe KV cache hit rate slightly down but latency improves.
Maya (oncall): Metrics now: p95=420ms, p99=1.3s for last 5m. Streaming stall counts down 78% vs peak.
Lina (eng-oncall): Good. Can we add a guard to reject or queue very long sequences with explicit backpressure instead of letting them block? Put as follow-up.
Richard (platform): Logged infra follow-up: add separate autoscale rule for longseq pool and apply stricter admission control.
Carol (support): Customer impact: two customers saw increased tail; no data loss reported, some requests timed out and were retried. I'm opening customer-facing postmortem stub.
Maya (oncall): Handing off to Jamie for overnight monitoring. I'll summarize actions taken in the ticket. Anyone else pick up follow-ups for tomorrow?
Jamie (sre): I'll own the post-incident checklist: bake hotfix, write test for mixed seq batching, and coordinate with runtime to avoid head-of-line blocking.
Rafael (runtime): I'll prototype batching similarity heuristic and add unit tests.
Lina (eng-oncall): I'll update the runbook with the new mitigation steps and add the canary commands used.
support-bot: Reminder: Incident severity set to Sev2. Next update in 30m.
Maya (oncall): Quick note for runbook: mitigation commands used (copy): ```kubectl patch cm cont-batcher-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"32","fair_scheduling":"true","long_seq_threshold":"1024"}}' kubectl scale deploy cont-batcher-longseq --replicas=3```
Jamie (sre): Also: for emergency revert: ```kubectl patch cm cont-batcher-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"128","fair_scheduling":"false"}}'``` — keep handy.
Carol (support): Filing update to affected customers now. Will append our mitigation and ETA for RCA.
Maya (oncall): last check: p95=390ms p99=1.1s, streaming stall spikes gone. Marking incident as mitigated but still monitoring. Leaving thread open for RCA notes. :white_check_mark:
